content: Oguchunguka kwa Saawulo
Mw'ezoola siku, Saawulo alichiri aderha okw'ayirha abemeezi ba Nnaweerhu. Aja emw'omudaahwa mukulu,
anamuhema amaruba m'okuja omu masinagoogi m'omu gishagala ch'eDamasiki, y'akabugaana yo abalume changwa abakazi bakulikiire eNjira ya Nnaweerhu, abashweke, anabaleerhe eYerusaleema.
Abeere ali omu njira hoofu ahike eDamasiki, ho n'aho, obumoleke bwarhenga empingu bwamugorha.
Ahenera ahashi, anava ayunva omulenge gwamubaza ntya: «Saawulo, Saawulo, girhumire wandibuza?»
Ashubiza ntya: «Nnaweerhu, wooyo oli nde?» Omulenge gwashubiza ntya: «Nyoono, ndi Yeesu, oli walibuza.
Aliko oyimange, oje omu gishagala. Omoola, bakubwira ech'okwaneene kujira.»
Abantu baliiri babalama haguma na Saawulo bayimanga buzira kuderha elugulu w'ogusoomerwa. Baliiri bayunva omulenge, aliko ntaaye baliiri baabona.
Saawulo ayimanga, azibuula ameesho, aliko ntaacho aliiri abona. Baava bamufarhira oku kuboko, bamuheeka eDamasiki.
Ajira siku esharhu buzira kubona, na buzira kulya changwa kunywa.
eDamasiki yaliiri omwemeezi oyirikwa Hananiya. Nnaweerhu amubonekera, amuhamagala: «Hananiya!» Naye ashubiza ntya: «Nyoono oyu, Nnaweerhu!»
Nnaweerhu amubwira ntya: «Yimanga, ogende omu njira eyirikwa ‹Elambuukire›, obaze omu nju ya Yuuda omuntu oyirikwa Saawulo w'eTariso. Ali asaliira mu kino gihe.
Omu kubonekerwa, abwene omuntu oyirikwa Hananiya aja omu nju, amanamulambuulira kw'amaboko y'ashube kubona.»
Hananiya ashubiza ntya: «Nnaweerhu, nayunvire bantu banene baderha obubi booshi oyoola muntu ajiriire abemeezi baawe eYerusaleema.
Chiro na hanoola, abakulu b'abadaahwa bamuheere obuhashe bw'ogushweka abantu booshi basaliira oku ziino lyaawe.»
Aliko Nnaweerhu abwira Hananiya ntya: «Genda, kwenge oyoola mulume ali gikoleeso nachishogere ch'okubala eziino lyaani embere z'abarhali Bayaahudi n'abaami baabo, n'embere z'aBaisraheeli.
Namuyeereka nyoono nyenyine amalibuko mooshi akwaneene kulibuka elugulu waani.»

Hananiya aja agenda. Abeere agera omu nju, alambuulira Saawulo kw'amaboko, anamubwira ntya: «Saawulo, mwene weerhu, Nnaweerhu Yeesu wakubonekeraga omu njira embere oyinje hano, antumire y'oshube kubona, onayunjule Muuka-Mutagatiifu.»
Ho n'aho, ameesho maage maarhoga kw'ebiri nk'amagamba, anashuba kubona. Ayimanga, anabatiizwa.
Aja alya ebiryo, anashuba kugwarha emisi. Saawulo abala oMwazi Mwinja eDamasiki Saawulo abeera siku zigeeke haguma n'abemeezi baliiri eDamasiki.
Ava arhondera kubala omu masinagoogi oku Yeesu ali Mwene Nnamahanga.

Booshi baliiri bamuyunva, basoomerwa; banalema babazana ntya: «K'arhali oyuula ye waliiri alibuza bweneene abasaliira eYerusaleema oku ziino lya Yeesu? K'arhanayinjaga hanoola kubashweka n'okubaheeka embere z'abakulu b'abadaahwa?»
Aliko obuhashe bwa Saawulo bwaliiri bwayuushuka omu gusoomeza aBayaahudi balilamire eDamasiki, omu kuyeereka bwinjabwinja oku Yeesu ye Krisitu.
Enyuma w'esiku zinene, aBayaahudi bahiga kuyirha Saawulo.
Aliko naye amenya ogo muhigo. Baliiri balanga emilyango y'egishagala ezuuba n'obudufu yi bamuyirhe.
Aliko obudufu, abigirizwa ba Saawulo bamurhoola, banamuyandagaza omu garhanda embuga w'olugurhu lw'egishagala.
Saawulo agaluka eYerusaleema
Saawulo agenda eYerusaleema. Abeere ahika yo, ashonda gurhe agachigusha haguma n'abemeezi, aliko booshi baliiri bamuyuubahire, kwenge barhaliyemereere oku abeere mwemeezi.

Baranaaba aja amurhoola, amuheekera eNtumwa. Abashambaalira gurhe Saawulo alibwene Nnaweerhu omu njira na gurhe Nnaweerhu ashambaalaga naye. Ashuba kubashambaalira gurhe Saawulo ayigirizaga buzira buuba eDamasiki oku ziino lya Yeesu.
Gurhengera echoola gihe, Saawulo alema alama haguma n'eNtumwa, alambagira haguma nabo omu Yerusaleema, analiiri ayigiriza buzira buuba oku ziino lya Nnaweerhu.
Aliiri ashambaala n'oguhatana n'aBayaahudi b'olulimi lw'eKigiriki. Aliko aboola bantu baliiri bashonda kumuyirha.
Abaabo babeere bamenya ogoola mwazi, baheeka Saawulo omu gishagala ch'eKayizariya, banamurhuma omu gishagala ch'eTariso.

Mw'echoola gihe, echigusho ch'abemeezi chaliiri omu murhuula omu Yudeeya yooshi, eGalilaaya n'eSamariya. Chaliiri chagwarha emisi, chalama omu kuyuubaha Nnaweerhu, n'okuyuushuka kugerera oburhabaale bwa Muuka-Mutagatiifu.
Ogufuma kw'Ayineya
Petero abeere ali agera ngasi hantu, ayandagalira emwa abemeezi baliiri balamire omu gishagala ch'eLuuda.
Abugaana y'omuntu oyirikwa Ayineya walihunzize. Alilyaamire oku gishanja gurhenga myaaka munaane.
Petero ava amubwira ntya: «Ayineya, Yeesu Krisitu amagufumya. Yimanga onazinge egishanja chaawe!» Ho n'aho ayimanga.
Abantu booshi b'eLuuda na b'omu bulambo bw'eSaroni babeere baabona Ayineya, bayemeera Nnaweerhu.
Ogufuulwa kwa Dorika
Omu gishagala ch'eYopa mwaliiri omukazi muguma mwemeezi wayirikwaga Tabita. Omu lulimi lw'eKigiriki ye Dorika
. Agendaga ajira ebijiro binene binja n'ebyo bubabale.
Mw'ezoola siku, alwala, anava afa. Bamuyooza, bamuheeka omu gorofa ebusiika.
Abemeezi babeere bayunva oku Petero ali eLuuda, hoofu n'eYopa, baarhuma balume babiri kumuyinginga ntya: «Rhuguhemere, yinja emwerhu buzira kulegama.»

Petero ayimanga, anava agenda haguma nabo. Bagerere yo, bamuheeka omu gorofa ebusiika. Abashumbakazi booshi baliiri ahoola bayegeera Petero eyi bali baalira. Baliiri bamuyeereka amalopo n'eyindi myambalo Dorika abahangiraga egihe aliiri mugumaguma.
Petero ahulusa abantu booshi, aja afukama, asaliira. Enyuma ahindamukira emunda omubiri gwaliiri, aderha ntya: «Tabita, yimanga!» Tabita aja azibuula ameesho. Abwene Petero, ayikala.
Petero amufarhira oku kuboko, amurhabaala kuyimanga. Aja ahamagala abashumbakazi n'abandi bemeezi, anabamoleka ye, eyi ali mugumaguma.
Eyoola myaazi yamenyeekana omu gishagala chooshi ch'eYopa n'abantu banene bayemeera Nnaweerhu.
Petero abeera eYopa siku zinene emw'omulume oyirikwa Simooni waliiri muhanga omu gukwiza empu.
